references.text: God showed his glory and signs in Egypt through plagues and wonders
Israel saw God's mighty deeds at the Red Sea
The people of Israel grumbled and tested God in the wilderness
The people tested the Lord at Massah
Moses reminds the people that they saw God's glory in the wilderness
Warning against testing the Lord as they did at Massah
The psalm describes how Israel tested God again and again in the wilderness and forgot his signs
Reference to how the fathers tested God and tried him even though they had seen his deeds
The people tested God in the wilderness
Hebrews quotes Psalm 95 about how the fathers tested God and saw his deeds for forty years
Paul warns against testing Christ as some of the Israelites did
